channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Israeli airstrike destroys Gaza City mosque near displacement camp
item.description: Video footage captures an Israeli airstrike hitting Al-Muttaqin Mosque in Gaza City, next to Yarmouk Stadium

item.title: Iran and Oman exchange proposals to manage Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Omani proposal is based on the Strait of Malacca model, where ships that use the strait provide voluntary fees.

item.title: Many feared dead from 7.1-magnitude quake in Kumamoto, Japan
item.description: A powerful 7.1-magnitude earthquake struck Kumamoto, Japan, causing widespread damage, injuries and fears of deaths.

item.title: Kyiv warns Iran against escalation after Ukraine’s Caspian Sea attack
item.description: Kyiv claims its Caspian Sea strike targeted Russian warships, denying intent to harm civilian vessels or individuals.

item.title: Lindsey Graham ‘almost cried’ tears of joy over war on Iran, footage shows
item.description: Excerpts from a planned documentary show the hawkish senator claiming credit for persuading Donald Trump to attack Iran.

item.title: War on Iran: Phase II: Day 17
item.description: Political déjà vu as US President Donald Trump says negotiations with Iran are back on.

item.title: Ukraine’s Zelenskyy hails ‘good meeting’ with Trump at White House
item.description: Discussions included joint production of Patriot missiles in Ukraine to bolster defence against Russian aerial attacks.

item.title: Mysterious deaths of 14 elephants in Kenya prompts urgent inquiry
item.description: It is the highest number of elephant deaths to be recorded in this area of southern Kenya in decades.

item.title: 'A lover of life' - Seattle pays tribute to food festival shooting victims
item.description: Families grieved on Monday as they remembered the three people killed in a shooting at a food festival.

item.title: Zoo staff rescue near-extinct snails from remote rock
item.description: Just 21 Madeiran land snails were found clinging to a rock on Portugal's Bugio Island, say conservationists.
